tool.name: Create.database
tool.description: creates a database file from a list, repnames, repfasta and contaxonomy file
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$otu' otu.dat && ln -s '$repfasta' repfasta.dat && ln -s '$nameOrCount' nameOrCount.dat && ln -s '$constaxonomy' constaxonomy.dat && ln -s '$group' group.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #if $otu.is_of_type("mothur.list"): #silent $mothur_args.append("list=otu.dat") #elif $otu.is_of_type("mothur.shared"): #silent $mothur_args.append("shared=otu.dat") #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("repfasta=repfasta.dat") #if $nameOrCount.is_of_type("mothur.names"): #silent $mothur_args.append("repname=nameOrCount.dat") #elif $nameOrCount.is_of_type("mothur.count_table"): #silent $mothur_args.append("count=nameOrCount.dat") #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("constaxonomy=constaxonomy.dat") #if $group: #silent $mothur_args.append("group=group.dat") #end if #if $label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str($label)) #end if
echo 'create.database(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.label: list or shared - OTU List of Shared
repname/count - Representative sequences
param.help: rep.name file or rep.count_table file generated by get.oturep

param.label: constaxonomy - Consensus Taxonomy
param.help: consensus taxonomy file output by classify.otu

param.label: label - OTU Labels
param.help: Select exactly one label. If none selected, first label in your list or shared file will be used

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The create.database_ command reads a list_ or shared_ file together with a consensus taxonomy, the representative fasta and the representative names dataset of get.oturep_, plus an optional group file, and returns the ``database`` dataset.
.. _list: https://mothur.org/wiki/list_file/ .. _shared: https://mothur.org/wiki/shared_file/ .. _get.oturep: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.oturep/ .. _create.database: https://mothur.org/wiki/create.database/
